captureVars.name: inboxFolderId
captureVars.description: Concrete Exchange BaseFolderId for the inbox, replacing the DistinguishedFolderId alias. Read from the DefaultFolderNames/DefaultFolderIds table in the session config response — the folder a request happens to target is whichever folder was last browsed, so request traffic cannot identify the inbox. The two arrays index each other positionally; the length-equality guard makes a compacted or otherwise unaligned pair a miss (falling back to the alias) instead of a plausible id for the wrong folder.
captureVars.jq: .responseBody | objects | .SessionSettings | objects | (.DefaultFolderNames // []) as $names | (.DefaultFolderIds // []) as $ids | select(($names | length) == ($ids | length)) | ($names | index("inbox")) as $ix | select($ix != null) | $ids[$ix] | objects | .Id | strings

captureVars.name: anchorMailbox
captureVars.description: x-anchormailbox routing header value (PUID or SMTP form) for this mailbox.
